plan: Final design document for QuaRot generalization to Phi-3-mini-4k-instruct (RTN vs GPTQ at INT4/INT6/INT8), design-only per the submission contract. Sections: (1) Objective; (2) Three falsifiable hypotheses H1-H3; (3) Model entry point as microsoft/Phi-3-mini-4k-instruct with BF16 baseline, load-time assertions on rope_scaling=None, fused qkv_proj shape, RMSNorm, hidden_size=3072 / num_attention_heads=32 / head_dim=96, and explicit non-quantized tensor list; (4) QuaRot pipeline including residual-stream Hadamard H_res with single-seed (K=1) Rademacher diagonal via pad-and-truncate construction, fused-linears per-axis rotation (shared H_res on input, per-head H_KV on K/V rows), K/V head-dim Kv-quant protocol with H_KV folded into W_k, W_v, and H_KV^T folded into o_proj, RMSNorm invariance argued from output-norm identity and orthogonality; (5) Method variants QuaRot-RTN (per-channel symmetric, no cal) and QuaRot-GPTQ (Hessian-based column-by-column on rotated X̃ from calibration forwards); (6) Quantization grid with W{n}A16 headline cells plus W{n}A{n} sub-grid plus A2 group=128 cells + QuaRot-KV cell; (7) Calibration WikiText-2 train 128x2048 single seed, BOS handling, no chat template; (8) Evaluation WikiText-2 + C4 PPL at seq-len 2048 sliding window, zero-shot suite PiQA, WinoGrande, HellaSwag, ARC-E, ARC-C, BoolQ, OBQA at 0-shot via lm-eval-harness, MMLU moved to ablation A4; FP16 reference mandatory on same harness version; (9) Ablation A0 (rotation on/off x {RTN,GPTQ} at W4A16), A1 (K=3 seeds for A0 cells), A2 (GPTQ group size per-channel vs 128 at W4A4 and W4A8), A3 (QuaRot-KV at W4A16), A4 (MMLU 0-shot headline cells); (10) Reporting head: 6-cell main table + sub-grid + Pareto figure, deterministic point estimates in headline, mean+/-std only in A1; (11) Risk table covering fused-linears row-order assertion, optional biases, RoPE scaling drift, QuaRot-KV isolation, MMLU instruction-tuning conflation, Phi-3 tokenizer chat-template stripping, GPTQ Hessian budget, and CPU INT4 impossibility; (12) Feasibility boilerplate verbatim per ruling #14 (current bubblewrap cannot execute even one forward pass; hypothetical future GPU host needs torch, transformers, datasets, lm-eval-harness and download access to microsoft/Phi-3-mini-4k-instruct, wikitext, c4, and zero-shot tasks); (13) Topic-note handling per ruling #15; (14) Consolidated list of all 15 rulings from the researcher's approval.
